title: Too small; fragile
text: Too small; fragile. Comes in a beautiful gift box. Upon unpacking I was bummed tho. Super small. The ceramic lining hold like 8oz. It broke the first use after placing it on my counter. Not really worth it to me.

product_metadata.title: The Miracle Travel Mug, Double Wall Insulated Tumbler, Ceramic Tourmaline Water Bottle, Juice, Tea and Coffee Tumbler, Double-Walled Ceramic Travel Mug with Leak-proof Lid, 12.3 oz, Emerald Green
features: Keep Your Drink in Best Condition - Looking for a travel mug that will enhance your drinking experience? Look no further than the Acera Miracle Travel Mug. This double wall tumbler is crafted with ceramic tourmaline lining that neutralizes chlorine, for safe and refreshing drinks.

Stay Hydrated On-the-Go - Sip your favorite beverage anywhere without worrying about spillage. Our travel coffee mug has a Tritan inner cap and silicone-seal liner, making it leak-free. Designed with non-slip hand grips, our ceramic cup is ideal for travel, office, gym and daily use.

Retains Optimal Temperature Longer - Have your hot and cold beverage at an ideal temperature with our ceramic travel mug. Designed with double wall insulation, our ceramic tumbler keeps your drink hot or cold for up to 2 hours.

Safe and Quality Materials - We ensure that our tumbler cups will not have a metallic taste over time. Our double wall tumbler meets international safety standards. Each ceramic coffee mug is made with no BPA, PVC, or phthalates and is lead-cadmium free.

Modern and Sleek Design - Each insulated mug from Acera is a veritable work of art - crafted with carefully-selected materials and embossed with various textures. Sip your coffee in a luxurious coffee cup that exudes elegance and functionality. Choose among our wide range of designs.
